name: Brewing Developments Screenshot Event
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ The "Brewing Developments" event has begun. In this event, the Traveler has received a request for aid from Hajanad, a student from the Sumeru Akademiya. Head to the Brewing Developments Domain and help Hajanad complete research on her Shock-Boiled Brews! Starting from April 24, sharing screenshots and Battle Chronicles of Brewing Developments on HoYoLAB will offer you a chance to claim Primogems!
